_comment: Entirely synthetic: invented people, invented drafts. This repo is public, so no real chat content belongs here — not even anonymised. The persona is a bilingual texter who writes short, lowercase, code-switched messages with no emoji and no final periods; each draft set below deviates on the dimensions listed in expect_off, and only those.
